decisions.reason: The deadline applies to completing the reference-matching qualification clip; it does not change the established submission channel or submission content.
The task-local deadline for the qualification clip does not change the monthly quota of 125 approved clips.
Completing the qualification clip today does not change the deferred Lead Clipper pathway, compensation, or training conditions.
The source message sets only a completion deadline and does not change the permitted source or source-selection constraints.
The deadline does not alter any caption color, font, or effects requirement.
The request to finish the qualification clip today does not modify the clean editing, effects, or transition standards.
The source decision changes timing for completion, not the required clip-duration range.
The deadline does not change the requirement that a clip contain a complete standalone lesson or story.
The source message establishes when the reference-matching clip should be completed but does not alter the moment-selection standard.
